description: A MANAGEMENT D_PDU carrying an Ed3 data rate change EOW is acknowledged and then refused with WARNING reason 3; an EOW type this node does not recognise also gets an UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR in the acknowledgement's EOW.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 2000 a MANAGEMENT D_PDU (type 6) from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, address size 4, EOT 10 (end 7000), VALID MESSAGE 1, ACK 0, frame ID 9, EOW 0x2A5: type 2, ED3-BASIC-RATE-RESPONSE, part of the Ed3 stop/start data rate change (C-0919), whose encoding is not in Ed4 and which this node treats as unrecognised (C-0400, C-0421). It is acknowledged (C-0296, C-0921), refused with WARNING reason 3, RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 6 (C-0920, C-0921, C-1071), and answered with UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR for type 2, EOW 0x302 (C-0445, C-0447), carried by the first D_PDU sent to 0.0.1.3, the acknowledgement (C-1079). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; 7000: rule 1, CONT_WAIT 45000; 52000: the acknowledgement (type 6, ACK 1, VALID MESSAGE 0, frame ID 9, EOW 0x302) then the WARNING (EOW 0), management first (C-0297, C-1041), EOT 10 each (one block, duration 5550).
